sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
jina: Procedure for dealing with discipline of Justices of Appeal
maudhui: (1) The procedure for dealing with discipline of Justices of Appeal for misconduct other than that specified in subarticle (2) shall be as prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament. (2) A Justice of Appeal may be removed from office for inability to perform the functions of his office, whether arising from illness or any other cause, or for misconduct, and shall not be removed except in accordance with a procedure similar to that prescribed for removal of a Judge of the High Court under subarticles (2) and (3) of Article 110A; for that purpose subarticle (4) of Article 110A shall apply to a Justice of Appeal in the same manner as it applies to a Judge of the High Court. (3) The provisions of this Article shall apply without prejudice to the provisions of subarticle (5) of Article 118 of this Constitution.
